title: andrographis laxiflora var. glomeruliflora
intro: Andrographis laxiflora var. glomeruliflora, commonly known as Himalayan Andrographis, is a plant species belonging to the family Acanthaceae. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cold, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan Andrographis include its immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral effects, which may help to boost the immune system and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Himalayan Andrographis include andrographolide, neo-andrographolide, and other flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
